sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies World Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases critical hit chance by 100%, and nullifies buff removal effects and debuffs) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 60000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 60000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +500
Only [First Steps] Krai & Tino can be used as Unlocking Potential material
